title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: EDHOC TH_4 test vector uses ciphertext, not plaintext
description:
## Found in code review of commit 5b527b2bff

**Location:** `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1634`

**Bug:** The standalone test for `transcript_4` at line 1634 computes TH_4 over `ciphertext_3` (the wire-format AES-CCM ciphertext parsed from message_3 bytes):

```rust
assert_eq!(
    transcript_4(&th_3, &ciphertext_3).unwrap(),
    th_4
);
```

Per RFC 9528 Section 3.5, TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3), not H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3). The `plaintext_3` variable already exists at line 1626 for this purpose.

**Impact:** The test vector `th_4` at line 1632 (`ad002457080da9a5e7a942030ca302f5cc9f77ba8124a49ba560d168b5b6f26d`) was derived from the wrong computation. It needs to be recomputed using `plaintext_3`.

**Fix needed:**
1. Change line 1634 from `&ciphertext_3` to `&plaintext_3`
2. Recompute the expected `th_4` hex value from the correct computation (H(CBOR(TH_3) || CBOR(PLAINTEXT_3))) using an independent oracle
3. The initiator-side fix in this commit (using `data_3` plaintext instead of encrypted `ciphertext_3`) is correct and complementary
